nodes.name: Apollo.io — Enrich Person
nodes.notes: Generic Credential Type → Header Auth. In credential: Name=X-Api-Key, Value=YOUR_APOLLO_KEY. Returns: email, email_status, person, organization.

nodes.name: Merge Enrichment Data
nodes.notes: Flattens Apollo response into a single lead payload. Email sourced from Apollo person.email (reveal_personal_emails=true) with trigger fallback.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 512, system: 'You are a B2B sales qualification expert. Analyze leads and return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown.

Scoring rubric:
- Company size: <10=5pts, 10-50=10pts, 51-200=20pts, 201-1000=30pts, >1000=20pts
- Seniority: C-level/VP=30pts, Director/Head=25pts, Manager/Senior=15pts, other=5pts
- Email quality: valid=20pts, risky=10pts, unknown=5pts, invalid=0pts
- Industry fit (SaaS/Tech/Finance/Healthcare): perfect=20pts, good=10pts, other=5pts

Return JSON: {"score": <1-100>, "tier": "hot|warm|cold", "reasoning": "<2 sentences>", "fit_signals": ["signal1","signal2"], "red_flags": ["flag1"]}', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Score this lead:

Name: ' + $json.first_name + ' ' + $json.last_name + '
Title: ' + $json.title + '
Seniority: ' + $json.seniority + '
Department: ' + $json.departments + '
Company: ' + $json.company + '
Industry: ' + $json.company_industry + '
Company Size: ' + $json.company_size + ' employees
Revenue: ' + $json.company_revenue + '
Founded: ' + $json.company_founded + '
Country: ' + $json.company_country + '
Email: ' + $json.email + ' (status: ' + $json.email_status + ')' }] }) }}

nodes.name: Claude API — Score Lead
nodes.notes: Generic Credential Type → Header Auth. In credential: Name=x-api-key, Value=YOUR_ANTHROPIC_KEY. Model: claude-sonnet-4-6.

nodes.name: Parse Score Response
nodes.notes: Extracts score/tier/reasoning from Claude JSON response. Graceful fallback on parse error.

nodes.name: Postgres — Insert Lead
nodes.notes: Insert operation with skipOnConflict=true. No raw SQL. Conflict key: email UNIQUE constraint in schema.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ content: "🟢 **" + ($json.hot_leads ? $json.hot_leads.length : 0) + " Hot Leads Detected**", embeds: ($json.hot_leads || []).slice(0, 10).map(lead => ({ title: String((lead.first_name || "Unknown") + " " + (lead.last_name || "") + " — " + (lead.score || 0) + "/100").substring(0, 250), description: String("**" + (lead.title || "N/A") + "** at " + (lead.company || "N/A") + "\n" + (lead.email || "N/A") + "\n" + (lead.reasoning || "")).substring(0, 2000), color: 5763719 })) }) }}

nodes.name: Discord — Hot Lead Alert
nodes.notes: No credentials needed. Paste Discord channel Webhook URL directly into the URL field. Embed color 5763719 = #57F287 (green).

nodes.name: Error Handler
nodes.notes: Attach via Error Workflow setting in workflow settings panel.
